reviewer: Owner-authorized implementer self-review, with GPT-6 assistance; not an independent review

reviewScope.summary: Feedback intake candidate with corrected protected-Preview authentication, keyboard navigation, source and bilingual privacy documentation, and safe upstream error diagnostics.
evidence: Owner-reported focused Vitest: 72/72 passed across three test files.
Owner-reported ESLint, Prettier, TypeScript, Vite build and git diff --check passed.
Protected Preview required same-origin credentials; the fixed client and architecture test were locally verified.
Microlearning keyboard navigation test updated and passed locally.
Nhost valid synthetic submission returned received with a receipt.
Nhost scheduled retention: 37 successful runs, daily schedule restored and synthetic expired report removed.
Owner-reported Node server tests: 4/4 passed; ESLint and Prettier checks passed after safe server-side diagnostics addition; source correction at commit 7789a977299155e23a985b3c39ad3138bac374e6.

Owner-provided Vercel runtime logs identified Nhost GraphQL access-denied for the previous server credential; subsequently the owner-provided Preview screenshot displayed 'Meldingen er mottatt' with receipt da2a8725-f658-40f5-9293-4359ecb5459c.

Direct Nhost storage readback for that receipt, live Vercel rate-limit enforcement/host coverage, ordinary authenticated-user denial, and hosted Final candidate certification remain separately unverified.

adversarialFindings.description: The feedback interface is present while the server-side inbox can still be disabled.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The API fails closed unless FEEDBACK_INTAKE_ENABLED=true and a server-side administrator secret exist. An owner-provided Preview screen confirmed a valid receipt after repairing the Nhost credential; production enablement still requires the remaining operational gates.

adversarialFindings.description: Provider firewall coverage, scheduled purge execution and actual learner-role access are not certified by source-only tests.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Synthetic SQL purge and scheduled execution were owner-verified (37 successful runs). A Vercel rate-limit rule was configured, but enforcement and all-hostname coverage have not been independently confirmed, and ordinary-user GraphQL denial still requires a live test. These are operational activation gates, not claims of source-only certification.

adversarialFindings.description: The public feedback form is not an appropriate destination for reporting security vulnerabilities.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The app and both documentation languages direct disclosures to the separate GitHub private vulnerability intake, rather than the feedback service.

adversarialFindings.description: Protected Vercel Preview rejected feedback requests without same-origin credentials.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Client now uses same-origin credentials. Server does not forward browser cookies to Nhost. Focused tests passed.

adversarialFindings.description: The new feedback button changed microlearning keyboard focus order.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Updated the accessibility test to verify both header controls and entry to the first session. Focused test passed.

retrospective.summary: Owner-authorized implementer self-review with GPT-6 assistance; no independent reviewer was used. Focused tests and owner-supplied Preview receipt support this source candidate. Full hosted release certification and production operational controls remain separate verifications.
